reports.headline: Flowers Left Where Nobody Died
reports.body: Every morning there are white flowers in the field {dir} of the village {dist}, laid out in a ring, and nobody admits to putting them there. {name} watched one night and saw crooked shapes come out of the dark toward the resident, and something enormous rise up and tear them apart before they could reach them.

reports.headline: It Was Protecting Them All Along
reports.body: {name} now believes the thing that hurt people at the cottage only ever struck those who meant the resident harm. In the field {dir} of here {dist}, the ring of white flowers grows every night, and at its centre the grass is pressed flat where two people sat.
